decisions.reason: As the current analytics plugin replacing the withdrawn Universal Analytics offer and fitting the firm's core shop-technology and analytics positioning, management is likely to keep supporting it and explain any modest results as temporary rather than admit a mistaken launch.

Because this SEO relaunch support service has its own page, is closely tied to the firm's publicly presented full-service e-commerce offer, and likely requires limited additional sunk cost to continue, management would be inclined to persist with it.

Although SEO workshops are somewhat less central than implementation services, they were only launched in 2024 and publicly promoted on their own page, so management would likely continue them for now and attribute any weak demand to a slow market ramp-up.
